recommendation_summary: Set up one externally hosted heartbeat monitor that edna pings after each successful sync, which emails the user if the ping misses its deadline, and then test it by deliberately skipping a ping.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want an alert when `nightly-sync` fails, without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central logging and Docker infrastructure for this one job.
labels.Bottleneck: The script sends its own email, so an early crash also kills the notification.

note: The reply recommends a single hosted heartbeat alert, drops the user's logging/Docker plan, and has all four record lines before the recommendation, each grounded in the facts given.
